name: Password Change Flow Handler
summary: Provides the typed application boundary for authenticated self-service password replacement and emits canonical success or failure transitions.
notes: The handler does not implement credential rules; it delegates to IPasswordManager and converts the resulting success state into one of two canonical transitions.
AuthenticationFlowService is the stable application front door used by REST and rejects transition keys outside this pair.

sourceReferences.note: Implemented typed handler and canonical transition selection.
Stable application front door for password change.
